Description: Unique identifier for each customer account
Legal business name of the customer company
Business Rule: Populated from CRM at contract signing

Description: Primary industry vertical of the customer
Subscription plan tier
Business Rule: Must be one of: Starter / Growth / Enterprise

Description: Monthly Recurring Revenue in USD for this customer
Geographic region of the customer headquarters
Employee headcount band of the customer
Date the customer first signed a contract
Date the customer cancelled their subscription. NULL if still active
Business Rule: NULL for active customers. Set on cancellation.

Description: Current account status
Business Rule: Must be one of: Active / Churned

Description: Composite health score from 0-100. Higher = healthier account
Business Rule: Computed daily from usage + tickets + billing signals

Description: Net Promoter Score from most recent survey (0-10)
Unique identifier for each billing transaction
Foreign key linking to the customer who generated this transaction
Transaction amount in USD. Negative values indicate refunds or downgrades
Business Rule: Refunds and downgrades are negative amounts

Description: Date the transaction was processed
Category of the billing event
Business Rule: One of: Subscription / Renewal / Upgrade / Downgrade / One-time Add-on / Refund

Description: Processing status of the transaction
Payment instrument used for this transaction
Business Rule: One of: Credit Card / ACH / Wire Transfer / Invoice

Description: Unique identifier for each support ticket
Foreign key linking to the customer who raised this ticket
Business area the ticket relates to
Urgency level assigned at ticket creation
Business Rule: One of: Low / Medium / High / Critical

Description: Current resolution state of the ticket
Business Rule: One of: Open / In Progress / Resolved / Escalated

Description: Date the ticket was submitted by the customer
Date the ticket was marked as resolved
Hours elapsed between ticket creation and resolution
Business Rule: SLA targets: Critical≤8h / High≤24h / Medium≤48h / Low≤96h

Description: Customer satisfaction rating submitted after resolution (1-5). NULL if not rated
Business Rule: 1=Very Unsatisfied. 5=Very Satisfied. NULL if customer did not rate.

Description: Free-text description of the issue as reported by the customer
Example Value: Dashboard loading slowly with multiple filters

Description: Unique identifier for each product usage session
Foreign key linking to the customer who generated this usage event
Date the usage session occurred
Name of the product feature used during this session
Duration of the usage session in minutes
Number of user actions performed during this session
Unique identifier for each customer onboarding record
Business Rule: Format: ONB + 4-digit number. One record per customer.

Description: Foreign key linking to the customer. One-to-one relationship.
Business Rule: Each customer has exactly one onboarding record

Description: Current or final onboarding stage reached by the customer
Business Rule: One of 5 stages: Account Setup / Data Migration / User Training / Integration Config / Go-Live

Description: Date the onboarding process was initiated. Equals contract_start date.
Date the customer reached Go-Live. NULL if onboarding not yet completed.
Business Rule: NULL for customers who have not completed onboarding

Description: Boolean flag indicating whether onboarding reached Go-Live stage
Number of calendar days from start_date to completion_date. NULL if not completed.
Primary reason onboarding is stalled or was delayed. 'None' if completed smoothly.
Business Rule: One of 6 defined blocker types or 'None'

Description: Unique identifier for each internal employee
Full legal name of the employee
Business department the employee belongs to
Job title of the employee
Business Rule: Role titles are defined per department

Description: Date the employee joined the company
Annual base salary in USD
Primary work location of the employee
Business Rule: One of 7 defined locations including Remote
